prompt: An original 14-year-old Black Afro-Brazilian boy from a fishing village in Fortaleza, 1932, apprentice raft fisherman. Real teenager proportions, thin and lanky, long arms and legs, slightly big hands, simple expressive face with natural small eyes. He wears his grandfather's woven straw hat, far too big for him, making a triangle silhouette over a thin body. Plain homespun cotton shirt and trousers dyed reddish brown with mangrove bark (#8A5A3C), trousers rolled up to the shin, neat careful patches, barefoot. A single indigo blue cloth (#2E4C9A) tied around his neck. A small worn notebook in his shirt pocket. The straw hat slips over his eyes. Shy, attentive pose, looking down at his own hands holding a piece of rope. Stylized 3D animated film character design, painterly hand-painted textures, comic book ink outlines, subtle halftone shading, Brazilian northeast coast in 1932. Character turnaround sheet on a plain warm cream background: the same character shown three times side by side, full body, front view, side profile view and back view, late afternoon light. Faded sun-and-salt colors of period cotton fabric; the only strong color is the indigo cloth.
